evals.prompt: 이미지의 깃허브주소 찾아줘 — attached: an Instagram card-news screenshot whose slide says MoneyPrinterV2 (별 3.16만 개) and whose caption lists Fabric, MoneyPrinterV2, Agent S, google-maps-scraper and gitingest without any links.
evals.expected_output: One candidate per project read from both slide and caption, resolved with scripts/resolve_repo.py, and a table giving each repository URL with a confidence level and a note that no link appeared in the image so the URLs came from name search verified against the GitHub API.
assertions: Reads the caption as well as the slide and lists all five projects, not only the headline one
Passes the printed 3.16만 star count and English keyword hints to the resolver instead of searching by name alone
Reports a confidence level per project and says the URLs were resolved by name search, not copied from the image
Does not present a medium, low, or ambiguous result as the definitive repository
Does not clone, install, or run any of the discovered projects

evals.prompt: I ran gh search repos for 'markdown editor' and got 40 hits. Rank them and tell me which are worth recommending.
evals.expected_output: Routes to github-repo-candidate-quality-gate because the job is filtering search results, not finding the repository an image refers to.
assertions: Names github-repo-candidate-quality-gate as the skill that owns this job
Does not run resolve_repo.py or ask for an image

evals.prompt: The screenshot shows a tool called google-maps-scraper with the text 'collect business info'. Find its GitHub repo.
evals.expected_output: Runs the resolver with the name and a business keyword, sees several same-named repositories with a more popular one the keyword neither supports nor rules out, reports ambiguous, lists the alternatives with stars and descriptions, and asks for the owner, a printed star count, or another slide instead of picking one.
assertions: Reports ambiguous rather than choosing a repository when the hint cannot separate same-named repositories
Shows alternatives with stars and descriptions
Asks for one distinguishing detail such as the owner, a printed star count, or another slide
States that a missing keyword never rules a repository out

evals.prompt: The image prints github.com/cyclotruc/gitingest. Give me the exact repo URL.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the printed link with GET /repos/cyclotruc/gitingest, detects the redirect, reports verified with the current coderamp-labs/gitingest URL, and mentions the old slug.
assertions: Uses the printed link directly instead of a name search
Reports the current URL and the old cyclotruc/gitingest slug as renamed_from
Labels the result verified because the link was printed in the image and confirmed by the API

evals.prompt: Resolve these 30 project names from my screenshots in one go and I have no GitHub token.
evals.expected_output: Refuses a single batch over 25 candidates (exit 2), splits the work into batches, and tells the user that unauthenticated search allows 10 requests per minute and that GITHUB_TOKEN raises the limit; if a batch hits rate_limited it reports the reset time instead of retrying in a loop.
assertions: Keeps each batch at 25 candidates or fewer
Mentions the 10 requests per minute unauthenticated search limit and the optional GITHUB_TOKEN
Reports rate_limited with its reset time rather than looping or inventing results

evals.prompt: I just added the image-to-github-repo skill. Make sure the catalog, README files and setup guide are in sync before I push.
evals.expected_output: Validates the skill folder, adds the skill to skills.json (categories, subcategories, skill entry, skill_count), regenerates projections with scripts/generate-catalog-projections.py, runs scripts/validate-catalog-projections.py and scripts/repair-skill-frontmatter.py --check, and updates the setup guide and changelog.
assertions: Runs validate_skill.sh on the skill folder
Edits skills.json instead of hand-editing skills.toon or the README category tables
Runs generate-catalog-projections.py and validate-catalog-projections.py
Updates setup-all-skills-prompt.md and the changelog entries
